title: Council of Avalon v Rider (an invented matter)
about: A man rides a bicycle through a park whose bylaw forbids vehicles. Three documents, one of them with a broken chain of custody; a word of open texture; a foreign court that read it broadly and a home court that will read it narrowly next year. Invented throughout.
